data.title: Hell in a Handbasket: Robotic Humanoid Torsos for Companionship  - Core77
data.description: Las-Vegas-based robotics company Realbotix is developing these Echo robots. These are companionship robots, imbued with AI software designed to carry conversations. To cut down on costs, the 'bots are just a head and torso, absent expensive joints and limbs. Four models are in
